one_liner: Customer support helpdesk with shared inbox, docs, and chat
blocker: API access requires a paid plan; the Free plan does not include API access or integrations

evidence.claim: Inbox API uses OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows, bearer token in Authorization header
evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.

evidence.claim: OAuth2 app credentials are created self-serve from the user profile
evidence.quote: You need to create an OAuth2 application before you can use the API. Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.

evidence.claim: API access is tied to paid plans; free plan excluded
evidence.quote: The Free plan does not include access to the API or integrations.

evidence.claim: Docs API uses an API key passed via HTTP Basic Authentication
evidence.quote: The API key is passed via HTTP Basic Authentication and goes in the username field. A dummy password, such as X, goes in the password field.

evidence.claim: Official, generally available MCP server exists for AI assistants
evidence.quote: Help Scout MCP gives AI assistants secure, official access to Help Scout data.

notes: Broad surface: Inbox API 2.0 (HAL+JSON REST at api.helpscout.net/v2) covers conversations, customers, mailboxes, reports; separate Docs API v1 and Chat API. Rate limits are plan-tiered: Standard 200/min (no reporting endpoints), Plus 400/min, Pro 800/min. Access tokens expire in 2 days with refresh-token flow. Official MCP server at mcp.helpscout.net/mcp is read-only, uses per-user OAuth, available on any plan with API access; report tools require Plus or Pro. Docs API key requires a specific permission granted by Account Owner/Admin.
